title: "RRF Distribution Analysis and Gamma Comparison"
format: html
editor: visual
---

# Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(fitdistrplus)
library(patchwork)
```

# Data Extraction

Data for RRFs are coming from the US FDA Clap List. https://cdrh-rst.fda.gov/chemicals-list-analytical-performance-clap

Each file is in a pdf format and contains RRF values for 3 concentration of a surrogate. LCMS RRFs CLAP Negative Ion Detection.pdf, LCMS RRFs CLAP Positive Ion Detection.pdf, RRF GCMS for CLAP.pdf.

We will treat values equal to 0.001 as left-censored (below detection limit).

```{r}
# GC/MS
gcms_clap <- read_excel(path = "processed_data/GCMS.xlsx", sheet = "GC-MS") %>% na.omit() 

# LC/MS POS
lcmspos_clap <- read_excel(path = "processed_data/LCMS.xlsx", sheet = "LCMSPOS") %>% na.omit()

# LC/MS NEG
lcmsneg_clap <- read_excel(path = "processed_data/LCMS.xlsx", sheet = "LCMSNEG") %>% na.omit()

# LOQ for censoring
loq <- 0.001

gamma_params <- data.frame()
```

# GC/MS Analysis

## 5 µg/mL

```{r}
v <- gcms_clap$"5 µg/mL"
v <- v[v != 0]
cens_data <- data.frame(
  left = ifelse(v <= loq, NA, as.numeric(v)),
  right = ifelse(v <= loq, loq, as.numeric(v))
)

fnorm <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "norm")
flnorm <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "lnorm")
fgamma <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "gamma")

summary(fnorm)
summary(flnorm)
summary(fgamma)

# Store gamma params
gamma_params <- rbind(gamma_params, data.frame(Technique = "GC/MS", Concentration = "5 µg/mL", shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]))

# Plot histogram and fits
RRF_df <- data.frame(RRF = as.numeric(v))
p_fit <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(x = RRF)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 20, fill = "lightgray", color = "white", na.rm = TRUE) +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, args = list(mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]), aes(color = "Normal"), linewidth = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = dlnorm, args = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), aes(color = "Log-normal"), linewidth = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = dgamma, args = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]), aes(color = "Gamma"), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Distribution", values = c("Normal" = "darkblue", "Log-normal" = "darkred", "Gamma" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(title = "GC/MS 5 µg/mL: Fit Comparison", x = "RRF", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()


# 1. Normal Q-Q Plot
qq_norm <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qnorm,
          # Updated to use fnorm$estimate
          dparams = list(mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]),
          alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qnorm,
               dparams = list(mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]),
               color = "darkblue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Normal Q-Q", x = "Theoretical Quantiles", y = "Sample Quantiles") +
  theme_minimal()

# 2. Log-normal Q-Q Plot
qq_lnorm <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qlnorm,
          # Updated to use flnorm$estimate
          dparams = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]),
          alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qlnorm,
               dparams = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]),
               color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Log-normal Q-Q", x = "Theoretical Quantiles", y = "Sample Quantiles") +
  theme_minimal()

# 3. Gamma Q-Q Plot
qq_gamma <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qgamma,
          # Updated to use fgamma$estimate
          dparams = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]),
          alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qgamma,
               dparams = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]),
               color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Gamma Q-Q", x = "Theoretical Quantiles", y = "Sample Quantiles") +
  theme_minimal()

# Display them side-by-side
qq_norm + qq_lnorm + qq_gamma
p_fit
```

```{r}
          alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qnorm,
               dparams = list(mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]),
               color = "darkblue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Normal Q-Q", x = "Theoretical Quantiles", y = "Sample Quantiles") +
  theme_minimal()

# 2. Log-normal Q-Q Plot
qq_lnorm <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qlnorm,
          # Updated to use flnorm$estimate
          dparams = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]),
          alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qlnorm,
               dparams = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]),
               color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Log-normal Q-Q", x = "Theoretical Quantiles", y = "Sample Quantiles") +
  theme_minimal()

# 3. Gamma Q-Q Plot
qq_gamma <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qgamma,
          # Updated to use fgamma$estimate
          dparams = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]),
          alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qgamma,
               dparams = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]),
               color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Gamma Q-Q", x = "Theoretical Quantiles", y = "Sample Quantiles") +
  theme_minimal()

# Display them side-by-side
qq_norm + qq_lnorm + qq_gamma
```

```{r}
v <- lcmspos_clap$"10 µg/mL"

flnorm <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "lnorm")
fgamma <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "gamma")

summary(flnorm)

RRF_df <- data.frame(RRF = as.numeric(v))
p_fit <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(x = RRF)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 20, fill = "lightgray", color = "white", na.rm = TRUE) +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, args = list(mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]), aes(color = "Normal"), linewidth = 1) +

  scale_color_manual(name = "Distribution", values = c("Normal" = "darkblue", "Log-normal" = "darkred", "Gamma" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(title = "LC/MS POS 10 µg/mL: Fit Comparison", x = "RRF", y = "Density") + theme_minimal()
```

# Gamma Distribution Comparison

Finally, we compare the Gamma distributions across concentrations for each technique.

```{r}
x_vals <- seq(0, 1.5, length.out = 500)

plot_data <- gamma_params %>%
  group_by(Technique, Concentration) %>%
  reframe(
    RRF = x_vals,
    Density = dgamma(x_vals, shape, rate),
    Probability = pgamma(x_vals, shape, rate)
  )

# PDF Comparison
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = RRF, y = Density, color = Concentration)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~Technique, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Gamma PDFs: Concentration Comparison", x = "RRF", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# CDF Comparison
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = RRF, y = Probability, color = Concentration)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~Technique) +
  labs(title = "Gamma CDFs: Concentration Comparison", x = "RRF", y = "Cumulative Probability") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
